mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", ability_id AS "abilityId", provider_id AS "providerId", ability_key AS "abilityKey", ability_kind_type_id AS "abilityKindTypeId", display_name AS "displayName", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.ability_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND ability_id = #{abilityId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.ability_definitions (game_id, ability_id, provider_id, ability_key, ability_kind_type_id, display_name, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{abilityId}, #{providerId}, #{abilityKey}, #{abilityKindTypeId}, #{displayName}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, ability_id) DO UPDATE SET provider_id = EXCLUDED.provider_id, ability_key = EXCLUDED.ability_key, ability_kind_type_id = EXCLUDED.ability_kind_type_id, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", ability_id AS "abilityId", provider_id AS "providerId", ability_key AS "abilityKey", ability_kind_type_id AS "abilityKindTypeId", display_name AS "displayName", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.ability_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, ability_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.ability_definitions_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, ability_id, provider_id, ability_key, ability_kind_type_id, display_name ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, ability_id, provider_id, ability_key, ability_kind_type_id, display_name FROM public.ability_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, ability_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, provider_id = EXCLUDED.provider_id, ability_key = EXCLUDED.ability_key, ability_kind_type_id = EXCLUDED.ability_kind_type_id, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name
